lines.en: I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: I should leave Io alone for now...
lines.zh: 现在我该让 Io 一个人待着……

lines.en: I tap on Io's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Io 的名字，等她接电话。
: 嘿！怎么了？
: 我还在盼着你打电话来呢。
: 是吗？

lines.en: : I'm actually about to leave work right now, and I was going to call you if you didn't call me first.
lines.zh: : 我其实正要下班，要是你没先打来，我就打算打给你了。

lines.en: : I'm actually on my way back from the convenience store right now and was just about to call you.
lines.zh: : 我其实正从便利店往回走，刚想打给你。
: 真是方便得不得了的巧合。
: 嘿嘿！超级方便。

lines.en: : Wanna go walk around the park or something?
lines.zh: : 要不要去公园走走什么的？

lines.en: : Nobody really goes to the one near the dorm, and there are a few trails there where nobody will bother us.
lines.zh: : 宿舍附近那个公园基本没人去，里面有几条小路，不会有人来打扰我们。

lines.en: : Sounds good to me. I'll start heading over now.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。我现在就过去。
: 太好了！
: 一会儿见，Sensei！

lines.en: Io and I spend the night roaming the park and talking about whatever crosses our minds.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 在公园里晃了一整晚，想到什么就聊什么。

lines.en: As a result, the conversation rapidly switches back and forth from the meaning of life to food...then back around to what it means to exist and then, finally-
lines.zh: 于是话题在人生的意义和食物之间来回横跳……然后又绕回存在的意义，最后——
虫子。

lines.en: As it turns out, Io isn't only a tomboy in her woodworking, handicraft, and baseball hobbies. She also likes to catch bugs and torment Uta with them.
lines.zh: 原来 Io 不只是木工、手工和棒球上的假小子，她还喜欢抓虫子，然后拿虫子去折腾 Uta。

lines.en: Their friendship becomes significantly stranger once I realize this, and I can't help but contemplate if Uta's pet beetle is somehow involved.
lines.zh: 意识到这一点之后，她们俩的友谊在我眼里变得更奇怪了，我忍不住琢磨 Uta 那只宠物甲虫是不是也掺和在里面。

lines.en: Either way, Io decides against tormenting {i}me{/i} and instead just points out and names facts about almost every single creature we come across.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Io 决定不来折腾{i}我{/i}，只是把我们路上遇到的几乎每一种生物都指出来，讲上几句。

lines.en: I find it impressive how she is essentially a fountain of biological knowledge and manage to refrain from including any of {i}my{/i} biological knowledge into the conversation as well.
lines.zh: 她简直就是一座行走的生物学知识喷泉，我很佩服——同时也忍住了没把{i}我{/i}那套生物学知识也塞进对话里。
那是个黄色笑话。
请笑一下。

lines.en: I find it impressive how she is essentially a fountain of biological knowledge and consider pushing her into further expanding that talent of hers once she gets out of college.
lines.zh: 她简直就是一座行走的生物学知识喷泉，我甚至在考虑等她大学毕业以后，推她一把，把这方面的天赋再扩展扩展。

lines.en: We end the night by sitting on a park bench for another half hour or so, not really talking about anything- but instead just staving off the cold and gazing up at streetlights.
lines.zh: 这一晚以我们在公园长椅上又坐了半个小时收尾，没聊什么正经的——只是挨着冷风，抬头看路灯。

lines.en: Io rests her head on my shoulder and ultimately falls asleep.
lines.zh: Io 把头靠在我肩上，最后睡着了。
$ io_love += 1
{i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}
